about_the_game:
This game: An RPG combining idle combat, spirit beast cultivation, and sect management

Core gameplay systems:

Full version contains the following features

Demo version has map restrictions (only first 3 maps), many spirit beasts unlock in later maps

1. Combat & Progression System

    []

    Intelligent idle combat system

    [/][]

    Multi-dimensional equipment system (affixes/set bonuses/quality tiers)

    [/][]

    Skill matrix system (200+ combinable skill modules)

    [/][]

    Spirit beast synergy system (5-beast squad strategy max)

    [/]

2. Cultivator Development System

    []

    Nine-stage breakthrough system (Qi Refining → Tribulation Transcendence)

    [/][]

    Lifespan countdown mechanic (Death upon expiration)

    [/]

3. Spirit Beast Codex System

    []

    Beast codex activation (Unlock by capturing new species)

    [/][]

    Ancestral talent network (Activated species grant racial bonuses)

    [/]

4. Celestial Forge System

    []

    Five Elements workshop (Elemental material fusion)

    [/][]

    Equipment crafting

    [/][]

    Affix refinement (Targeted attribute extraction/transfer)

    [/]

5. Dynamic World System

    []

    Main story-driven narrative (300+ branching plots)

    [/][]

    Permanent NPC death (Key characters affect worldlines)

    [/][]

    Open world structure (Seven Spirit Realms + secret zones)

    [/]

6. Sect Ecosystem

    []

    Nine-rank promotion system (Outer Disciple → Grand Elder)

    [/][]

    Monthly stipend system (Position-based spirit stone/resources)

    [/][]

    Archives' secret techniques (Unlock ancients arts with sect contribution)

    [/][]

    Four Symbols Tournament (Quarterly sect rankings)

    [/]

7. Spirit Refinement Pagoda

    []

    Five Elements environment control (Metal/Wood/Water/Fire/Earth fields)

    [/][]

    Beast evolution tree (Basic forms → Ancient variants)

    [/][]

    Environmental adaptation mechanics:

    [/]

▫ Incubation boost (Wood realm speeds plant-type eggs)

▫ Bloodline purification (Element synergy triggers rare affixes)

▫ Core refinement (Element alignment enhances absorption)

▫ Beast rebirth (Fallen beasts revive with random buffs)

▫ Pagoda trials (Dynamic element counters)
